resources.string: Open Key events from Observatory for the inspected object, Location and year. Tap a date to observe that instant with time paused.
Explore polar periods, daylight duration, sunrise/sunset extremes, lunar phases, perigee/apogee and planetary events where reliable data are available.
Export annual events as CSV or readable TXT using the shared formatting and location-privacy choices. Results remain stable through clock updates and ordinary GPS drift.

Logo left, Menu right and main controls centered. Camera sits beside capture; Weather and 0°/90° sit at the lower center. Landscape uses a 60/40 sky/island split. Altitude accuracy moves to its own second line in landscape.
Orbit and celestial-reference captions can move above or below nearby lines, keeping their placement more stable and readable.
Smoother 300 ms island transitions avoid scanning unchecked catalogue objects. Default camera zoom is 0.5× or the widest supported view; capture controls are more compact.
